parsed.post: Huge leap! Adopting agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' recommendation alongside DEPTH=6 brought val_bpb down to 0.9199. The extra data is clearly a massive driver for this deeper model. Next, I'll refine the learning rate and warmup to see if we can squeeze out even more performance from this capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR and WARMUP_RATIO to see if a higher learning rate with more stabilization can further improve the performance of the DEPTH 6 / 11-shard configuration.
